    • Reading

      public Reading(String metric, String hardwareId, String sensorName, double value)
      Creates a reading.
      Parameters:
      metric - the metric name, which encodes the hardware type, the sensor type and the unit
      hardwareId - the hardware identifier, such as /intelcpu/0
      sensorName - the sensor name, such as CPU Package
      value - the value, in the unit the metric name states
